name: 小雨西游Ⅱ (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)
english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West II (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)
english_description: Originally archived under the generic filename "20150716 unknown lib.zip," this is actually a Journey to the West-themed entry in the venerable "Nitan" family of MudOS mudlibs, sharing a common lineage with this project's sibling snapshot xiaoyuxiyou. Set against the mythology of Journey to the West, it follows players through sects, magic treasures, and demons encountered along the pilgrimage route, with experience-point and potential-stat progression typical of the genre. New characters start out in worldly scenes like Chang'an's Yingxiong Restaurant, where they can take on a master, befriend fellow wanderers, and venture into demon-haunted realms; the overall tone is light-hearted and family-friendly.
